versions.changelog: Remove browser automation code examples to maintain true credential-free design
Privacy disclosure: warn users about credential transmission to cloud services in data collection guide
Add data collection guide with browser-use instructions for scraping ghin.com
Security: restrict to .json files only, validate GHIN data structure, sanitize error messages to prevent file content leakage

Initial release of GHIN Golf Tracker with comprehensive local analysis of GHIN golf statistics.

- Provides detailed analysis of GHIN data from a local JSON file, including handicap trends, scoring breakdowns, and course performance.
- Outputs human-readable reports and machine-readable JSON summaries.
- No network access, file writes, web scraping, or credential storage—data analysis only.
- Handles errors for missing files and malformed data gracefully.
- Requires only Python 3.8+ and the standard library.
